charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1101_0100_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] spotted
Sharpedo and Matt on a beach.
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_0300_:
Now that you’re here, I gotta get even more
pumped up!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_0500_:
There’s only one thing to do by the sea with
Pokémon! And that’s training!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_0600_: Sharpedo and I train here every day!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_0401_0800_: You bet! He’s as important to me as my bro!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_0402_1000_: Oho! Sharpedo and I are in perfect shape!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_1100_: My bro entrusted him to me, after all!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_1200_:
Raising Sharpedo as best as I can is my way
of showing my bro gratitude!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_1300_:
With that in mind, I’ve been training my
body—and my Pokémon’s, too!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_1400_:
I want us to prove ourselves by taking down
an interesting, strong dude.
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_1900_:
Oho! I’ve got it! That Team Magma guy who
looks like a Makuhita!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_2000_:
Team Aqua and Team Magma are like rivals
anyways, so I don’t wanna lose to him!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_2200_:
[Name:PlayerNickname ], I wanna take
you down too someday!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_2400_:
Besides, my bro’s taken an interest in you!
No way I can let you beat me!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_2500_:
When we battle for real, I’ll smash you up
real good!
charaepi_ch0223_00_ushio/2301_1201_2600_: Me and Sharpedo will train even more!
